verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents that Claude loads skills automatically when they are relevant to a natural-language task, with the skill description saying when to use it. Hands-on community reports concretely contradict that triggering: users say skills often aren't invoked from natural-language requests, and a cited Vercel eval found the skill was never invoked in 56% of cases. Missing for 10: reliable natural-language triggering confirmed by independent testing, and documented accuracy or behaviour guarantees for natural-language invocation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Claude uses skills when relevant, or you can invoke one directly with `/skill-name`.
If Claude thinks the skill is relevant to the current task, it will load the skill by reading its full `SKILL.md` into context.
Use when working with PDF documents or when the user mentions PDFs, forms, or document extraction.
